steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test.
Allow the vendor to be added during event creation.
Set the project title required for publishing and later identification.
Configure the project with an RFQ stage only.
Configure the RFQ stage.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB line item with quantity 10.
Populate the RFQ pricing sheet after adding the line item.
Set the requested delivery location on the line item.

args.goal: on the RFQ project create screen, open Add T&Cs, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", enable "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory", verify both clauses show "Overridden by Mark all mandatory", click Done, and stop with the saved project-level terms configuration visible

steps.note: Configure and verify the two mandatory project-level clauses, which have no dedicated catalog step.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Add one QA vendor to the RFQ.
Publish the configured RFQ project.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Open the invited QA vendor's supplier portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open this event's RFQ pricing round in the vendor portal.
Accept the first mandatory project-level clause.
Accept the second mandatory project-level clause.
Quote 100 for the line item and submit after accepting both terms.
Verify that the vendor portal shows the bid as submitted.
Return to the buyer's event page.
Verify that the buyer sees the vendor response on the RFQ stage.

args.text: Vendors who have placed the bid, have accepted the Terms and Conditions.

steps.note: Verify the buyer-facing confirmation that the responding vendor accepted the terms.
